messages:
lina: hi all, I'm Lina (SWE) starting today. Quick onboarding Q: where do I ask about VPN access, badge pickup, and who to bother for a dev VM?

carlos: welcome Lina! Badge/paperwork -> #help-access and tag @people-ops. VPN/okta issues -> #eng-infra. For dev VMs post in #eng-platform with your repo and a short reason.

maya: +1. If it's blocking your ramp, DM @infra-oncall or drop a message in #eng-infra and include your machine hostname and error.

onboard-bot: Welcome Lina! Run `/onboard start lina@redwood.ai` to get your buddy and checklist. Check pinned items in #new-hires for quick links.

lina: where do teams usually post quick PR review asks and cross-team design reviews? #eng vs #architecture?

carlos: PR review: put everything in the PR first. If you want a ping, post a 1-line with the PR link in #eng and mention 1-2 reviewers. Design reviews that affect multiple teams -> #architecture. Team-level designs -> #eng-platform or the team's channel.

maya: etiquette reminders: 1) use threads to keep channels tidy, 2) react to acknowledge, 3) avoid @channel for single-person requests, 4) summarize context in 1-2 lines + link to docs.

infra-bot: To reduce alert noise, subscribe to only the services you touch: `/alerts subscribe lina --team infra --severities P0,P1`. Contact #eng-sre for help.

lina: bots: where do I request a new remind-bot schedule or change standup times?

devex-team: Bot/config requests -> open an issue in #devex with: bot name, channel, cron, message text, and a maintainer. We prefer scheduled reminders not to use @channel. If a bot is noisy, include timestamps and a sample message.

carlos: social stuff: #lunch-plans for meals, #random for non-work chat. Company-wide announcements -> #general but keep it short and link to calendar invites for events.

lina: thanks everyone, super helpful. I'll start the onboard flow and ping if my laptop won't talk to Okta :wave:
